items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Who was the cat who used to write for Esquire? Miller?

ctx.x: We just wouldn't have thought about it. I got the first idea when that cat (?) took Big-Eye Louis' picture. He was the ...(?). giving hell. Who was the cat who used to write for Esquire? Miller?
Miller, yeah. Oh, that was Miller. Paul...
